properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key for HMAC-SHA signature of JWT access tokens.

properties.name: app.jwt.cookie-name
properties.description: Name of the HttpOnly authentication cookie.

properties.name: app.jwt.cookie-secure
properties.description: Whether the auth cookie should have the Secure flag enabled.

properties.name: app.jwt.cookie-same-site
properties.description: SameSite policy for the authentication cookie (Lax, Strict, None).

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Allowed CORS origins for the frontend clients.

properties.name: app.seed.enabled
properties.description: Whether development sample data seeding is enabled on startup.
